_comment_compressor: 'repo' wires this project's real hybrid encoder. It currently raises NotImplementedError because src/token_language/encoder/ is empty -- see README 'Missing integration'. A live run cannot use the mock compressor; the runner refuses it.
_comment_generation: max_tokens must cover REASONING tokens plus the answer. deepseek-v4-flash is a reasoning model: with a small budget it returns content=null and finish_reason=length, which the adapter reports as a truncated_before_answer error rather than grading it as a wrong answer. Both arms use the identical budget.
_comment_pricing: Versioned, operator-supplied pricing in USD per token. Never fetched or assumed; leave null to report cost as unknown. Values below are from the OpenRouter model listing observed 2026-09-19 and MUST be re-verified before use.
notes: Live first-attempt quality experiment. Credentials come from OPENROUTER_API_KEY in the environment, never from this file.
